business_type_and_industry: Specialty coffee retailer and coffee roaster offering handcrafted customized blends, packaged coffee, subscriptions, and wholesale programs. Source: https://philzcoffee.com/our-story
location_and_service_area: Founded in San Francisco, with an Oakland, California roasting facility and contact address. Retail locations span California and Chicago, including San Francisco, East Bay, Peninsula/South Bay, Sacramento Valley, Los Angeles, Orange County, Ventura County, San Diego, Inland Empire, and Chicago. Sources: https://philzcoffee.com/our-story; https://philzcoffee.com/locations
number_of_locations: Multiple retail locations across the listed California regions and Chicago; the official locations page does not state a total count in the crawled content. Source: https://philzcoffee.com/locations
workplace_or_customer_traffic: Customer-facing retail footprint with stores generally opening early and operating through afternoon or evening; the locations page lists openings as early as 4:30–5:00 a.m. Source: https://philzcoffee.com/locations
existing_coffee_service: Operates its own handcrafted coffee shops and roasting facility. Its wholesale program serves offices, grocery stores, and special occasions, but excludes partnerships where Philz coffee would be brewed for resale. Sources: https://philzcoffee.com/wholesale; https://philzcoffee.com/careers
products_or_services_offered: Handcrafted coffee, customized blends, sustainably sourced roasted beans, whole-bean coffee, K-Cup pods, subscriptions, merchandise, gift cards, rewards/app ordering, retail, and wholesale coffee programs. Sources: https://philzcoffee.com; https://philzcoffee.com/our-story; https://philzcoffee.com/wholesale
hospitality_or_food_and_beverage_evidenc: Coffee-focused food-and-beverage operator with retail coffee shops, baristas, store operations, roasting, production, and shipping teams. Source: https://philzcoffee.com/careers
target_contact_and_job_title: Primary wholesale contact is the Wholesale Inquiries team at wholesale@philzcoffee.com. Andy Mai, Chief Business Officer, oversees Technology, Marketing, Supply Chain, and the Roasting Plant. Sources: https://philzcoffee.com/wholesale; https://philzcoffee.com/our-leadership
contact_information: Wholesale: wholesale@philzcoffee.com. General: info@philzcoffee.com. Address: 680 85th Ave, Oakland, CA 94621. Sources: https://philzcoffee.com/wholesale; https://philzcoffee.com/contact; https://philzcoffee.com
business_need_or_sales_use_case: Potential fit for office coffee programs, grocery-store placement, and special-occasion coffee supply through Philz’s stated wholesale program. Qualify that the arrangement must preserve Philz’s ownership of the customer experience and cannot involve brewing coffee for resale. Source: https://philzcoffee.com/wholesale
budget_or_purchasing_signals: Formal wholesale program and recurring coffee subscriptions are advertised, but no wholesale budget, purchasing volume, or procurement terms are published. Sources: https://philzcoffee.com/wholesale; https://philzcoffee.com
growth_hiring_or_expansion_signals: Current openings span retail, warehouse/roasting and production, and home-office functions. The leadership page identifies a Chief Development Officer responsible for real estate and growth, while the company promotes store openings through its newsletter. Sources: https://philzcoffee.com/careers; https://philzcoffee.com/our-leadership; https://philzcoffee.com/our-story
brand_and_customer_experience_fit: Experience-led brand centered on “Better Days,” warmth, sincerity, care, customized coffee, community, handcrafted cups, sustainable sourcing, compostable serviceware, and customer/team focus. Sources: https://philzcoffee.com/our-story; https://philzcoffee.com/sustainability; https://philzcoffee.com/careers
qualification_evidence_and_source_links: https://philzcoffee.com/our-story; https://philzcoffee.com/locations; https://philzcoffee.com/wholesale; https://philzcoffee.com/careers; https://philzcoffee.com/sustainability; https://philzcoffee.com/our-leadership; https://philzcoffee.com/contact
prospect_priority_and_rationale: High priority only for office coffee, grocery-store, or special-occasion opportunities that do not involve third-party brewing for resale.
